title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — Schedule of Transfer Limits by Tier
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan.** This schedule fixes, for each of the six plan tiers, the limits that govern how much earned pay a worker may receive early and how often. The tier that applies is the tier the plan holds when the transfer is booked.

| Tier | Access percentage of the current pay period's accrued net earnings | Pay-period dollar ceiling | Daily dollar ceiling (Eastern Time calendar day) | Largest single transfer | Smallest single transfer | Transfers per day | Transfers per pay period | Accrued net required before the period's first transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Access Starter | 25 percent | 150.00 USD | 100.00 USD | 100.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 1 | 3 | 50.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Standard | 35 percent | 300.00 USD | 150.00 USD | 150.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 2 | 5 | 40.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Plus | 40 percent | 500.00 USD | 250.00 USD | 200.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 2 | 6 | 30.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Preferred | 50 percent | 750.00 USD | 300.00 USD | 300.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 3 | 8 | 25.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Premier | 50 percent | 1000.00 USD | 400.00 USD | 400.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 3 | 10 | 20.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Premier Plus | 60 percent | 1500.00 USD | 500.00 USD | 500.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 4 | 12 | 20.00 USD |

## What each column means

- **Access percentage** — the percent of the current pay period's accrued net earnings the worker may receive early.
- **Pay-period dollar ceiling** — the dollar ceiling on early wage transfers booked against one pay period.
- **Daily dollar ceiling** — the dollar ceiling on early wage transfers booked on one calendar day, Eastern Time.
- **Largest single transfer** and **smallest single transfer** — the largest and the smallest single early wage transfer.
- **Transfers per day** — the number of early wage transfers allowed on one calendar day, Eastern Time.
- **Transfers per pay period** — the number of early wage transfers allowed against one pay period.
- **Accrued net required before the period's first transfer** — the accrued net earnings the current pay period must reach before its first transfer.

## Reading the schedule

- The smallest single transfer is the same 5.00 USD on every tier; every other limit rises or holds steady from Paystride Access Starter to Paystride Access Premier Plus.
- Paystride Access Preferred and Paystride Access Premier share the 50 percent access percentage and the three-transfer daily count; they differ in the pay-period ceiling (750.00 against 1000.00 USD), the daily ceiling (300.00 against 400.00 USD), the largest single transfer (300.00 against 400.00 USD), the per-period count (8 against 10) and the first-transfer threshold (25.00 against 20.00 USD).
- Paystride Access Premier and Paystride Access Premier Plus share the 20.00 USD first-transfer threshold.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A plan on Paystride Access Plus is limited to 2 transfers on one Eastern Time day and to 250.00 USD across that day; no single transfer may exceed 200.00 USD or fall below 5.00 USD.
